result.markdown:
For a small company, I'd recommend choosing HR software that makes it easy to manage employees, onboarding, vacation requests, time tracking, payroll, and employee documentation without needing a full-time HR administrator.

**My top recommendation is BambooHR for dedicated HR management, or a Canadian-focused platform if you want HR and payroll together.**

The best option depends on how many employees you have and whether you want payroll included.

## Best HR software for small businesses

(Best overall for Canadian businesses)

- Canadian HR and payroll
- Employee onboarding and records
- Vacation and leave management
- Benefits administration
- Hiring and employee self-service

Payroll starts around \$7/employee/month, subject to a \$70 monthly minimum. HR pricing is quote-based. search_results.description: TechRadar’s 2026 guide evaluates leading HR software for payroll, compliance, recruitment, onboarding, benefits, performance management, and employee administration. Gusto is named best overall for its full-service payroll, time tracking, benefits administration, compliance support, and HR guidance. Employment Hero is recommended for small and medium-sized businesses because of its customizable workflows, automation, AI assistant, and broad feature set, though advanced functions and add-ons can increase costs. Rippling is best for versatility, particularly for distributed teams, offering remote device management, tax registration, scalable services, and per-employee billing. Other recommendations include Remote Payroll for international enterprises, BambooHR as an all-in-one system, Zoho People for integrations, Breathe HR for simple employee management, Deel for powerful global HR capabilities, PeopleHR for mobile access, Paylocity for mid-sized businesses, Staffology Payroll for complex enterprise payroll, Workable for recruitment, and BrightHR for extensive workforce-management features. The guide advises selecting software according to company size and specific workflow needs, and explains that testing considered usability, features, security, support, pricing, and user feedback.
